verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm Spotlight as a built-in search tool that lets users "search and take action without opening apps" and can surface "Ask Siri" as a top hit, so macOS does ship a native search launcher. The evidence never states which content types it covers (files, apps, settings), how it is invoked globally, or how fast it is. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of file, app, and settings search coverage, global hotkey invocation, speed/instant results, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
